dialogue_intro: One exchange, the way it runs on your own WhatsApp number. The fee, the times and the names are examples.

dialogue.text: hi, do you still have space for p1 next year? my girl starts at the primary school next to you in jan
Hi! Yes, there are P1 places for January. Since she is at the school next door, our staff walk her over after dismissal. Will she need us five days a week, or fewer?
5 days. how much is it a month? any subsidy?
Five days is S$600 a month. Lunch and a tea break are included. There is no government subsidy on our programme, so that is the full fee. In the school holidays we open from 8am instead of 1.30pm.
ok. can we come and see the place this saturday?
Yes. The principal shows families around on Saturday at 10am or 11.30am. Which one suits you?
Saturday 11.30am is yours. Can I take your name and your daughter's name for the visit?
mdm lim, her name is xin yi
Thank you, Mdm Lim. Saturday 11.30am with the principal is confirmed, and I have sent the address. If anything changes before Saturday, just message here.

flow.detail: A parent asks if there is a place for P1 in January or for K1 next term. The agent checks the places list you gave us, or on Pro your live sheet, and says yes, no, or waitlist. Then it asks which school or how old the child is.

flow.step: It quotes the fee and what is included
flow.detail: Five days or three, term time or holiday programme only, meals in or out. It quotes from your fee sheet and says plainly whether a subsidy applies, in your words. It never rounds a fee or guesses one.

flow.step: It asks the one question that qualifies the lead
flow.detail: Which school, which level next year, and when the child starts. A parent with a real child answers in a line. The form-fillers who only wanted the fee drop out here, which one centre told us was many of its ad leads.

flow.step: It books the centre visit or the open house slot
flow.detail: It offers two times from your calendar, takes the parent's name and the child's name, and confirms the slot in the chat. If the parent asked the fee and went quiet, it follows up.

flow.step: It hands over to the principal
flow.detail: A subsidy question beyond your sheet, a child with late dismissal, special needs, a parent who wants to negotiate the fee. The agent says it will have the principal reply, and you get the whole conversation in one message with the name, the child's level and the visit time.

systems: On Starter it reads your fee sheet, your places list by level, the schools you escort from, your hours and open house dates, and your calendar link for visits, all sent to us on WhatsApp. On Pro it reads and writes the Google Sheet you track places and visits in, or the enrolment system you already use, so the vacancy answer is live and every booked visit lands in your sheet. faq: Can an AI agent tell a parent whether we have a place for their child?

Yes, from the places list you give us, by level and by year. On Starter you send us the list on WhatsApp and update it when it changes. On Pro the agent reads the Google Sheet or system you track places in, so the answer is live. If a level is full it offers the waitlist and takes the parent's details for it.
How does it handle fees and subsidies?

It quotes from your own fee sheet, by days per week and by programme. It states what is included, such as meals or the holiday programme, in your words. On subsidies it says exactly what you tell it to say and no more. A family with a subsidy question that goes beyond your sheet is passed to the principal with the conversation attached.
Can it book centre visits and open house slots?

Yes. It offers times from your calendar link, takes the parent's name and the child's name, and confirms the slot in the chat. The visit lands on your calendar with the parent's number. For an open house it registers the family the same way.
What happens with a question it cannot answer, like a child with late dismissal or special needs?

It says it will have the principal reply and stops there. You get one message with the parent's name, the child's level, the question and the whole conversation. You reply to the parent yourself. It never guesses at a place, a fee or a yes.
How long does it take to set up for a preschool or student care centre?

Live in 48 hours from the day we have your fee sheet, places list, escort schools, hours and calendar link. We build the agent before you pay anything. You message it the way a parent would. Then one free hour where we walk you through the platform and connect your WhatsApp and payments.
What does 41 Closer cost for a childcare or student care centre?

Starter is S$690 a month. Pro is S$1,490 a month and connects to your own sheet or system. The build is included and there is no setup fee. Connecting a system we have connected before is a one-time S$2,400. One month to start, charged from go-live, then month to month with 30 days notice and no contract.
Does it work with the leads from our Facebook ads?

The agent answers every parent who messages your WhatsApp, including from a click-to-WhatsApp ad. A lead form entry sits in Ads Manager until a person opens it, which is where one centre's 24 to 48 hour delay came from. So point the ad at WhatsApp, and the first message is answered in the first minute. If your ads bring junk leads, the agent will not fix that, and we will tell you so.
Is this the same as the auto-reply on WhatsApp Business?

No. An auto-reply sends one fixed line and the parent still waits for a person. The agent reads the question and answers it from your sheet, asks which level and which school, and books the visit. If you only get a few enquiries a month, the auto-reply is enough and we will say so.
